Tara Lim (CSM): quick heads-up — ExplainerLabs says they're ready to spin up ~8-12 additional workspaces and a nightly ingest pipeline. They want per-workspace embeddings + semantic search. low churn risk but this is a meaningful throughput bump.
Ben Ortiz (AE): nice, does the customer have rough qps or token numbers?
Tara Lim (CSM): they quoted ~180 qps peak for embedding requests and ~600 tps peak for interactive chat playgrounds; expecting overall usage to ~2x in 3 months. asking if we can support per-workspace isolation or a cheaper shared routing.
Sophie Nguyen (Onboarding): timeline? if they want workspace-level routing we need a playbook + role mappings. i can run an enablement session next Wed.
Ravi Patel (Infra): capacity flag — per-workspace isolation likely means 3-4 extra pods or an autoscale policy tweak depending on model / seq lengths. can they tolerate async batching for embeddings to reduce cost?
ExplainerLabs (external): @Tara we can do nightly batch for most users but need embeddings refreshed within ~4 hours for search relevance.
Tara Lim (CSM): got it — leaning toward hybrid: batched nightly plus a small realtime endpoint for critical teams. keeps cost down but meets freshness.
Ben Ortiz (AE): solid expansion for renewal next quarter. i'll own pricing so we don't surprise them. can someone estimate monthly embedding/token units so i can draft tiers?
Ravi Patel (Infra): quick back-of-envelope: assume 10 workspaces, 50k embeddings/day -> ~500k embedding units/month. chat sizing needs more detail but i will run the sizing script and post numbers.
Sophie Nguyen (Onboarding): onboarding checklist i need: workspace routing doc, sample IAM policies, onboarding playbook, sample prompt templates. i'll assemble and share.
Tara Lim (CSM): scheduling call with customer + infra + AE. propose Tue 10am PT. @Ben @Ravi possible?
Ben Ortiz (AE): yep.
Ravi Patel (Infra): yep.
Sophie Nguyen (Onboarding): yep.
Tara Lim (CSM): created CS ticket CS-2971 to track expansion and enablement. tagging @Ravi to own the capacity estimate :memo:
Ravi Patel (Infra): taking it. i'll post exact numbers and a minimal config suggestion shortly:
```
{
  "pods": 4,
  "embedding_qps": 200,
  "chat_peak_tps": 600,
  "freshness_hours": 4
}
```
Tara Lim (CSM): perfect. i'll send the calendar invite and prep the playbook. :thumbsup:
deploy-bot: meeting created: https://calendar.example.com/event/abcd
Ben Ortiz (AE): i'll prep a couple pricing tiers (shared vs isolated) and share a draft here. :moneybag:
Sophie Nguyen (Onboarding): adding onboarding checklist to Notion: https://notion.example/expansion (will link templates)
Tara Lim (CSM): quick reminder: ask the customer which models they'd like pinned or if they're open to our quantized / cost-optimized variants.
ExplainerLabs (external): prefer smaller cost-friendly models for embeddings and latest for chat. we'll list exact model names before the call.
Tara Lim (CSM): great — closing this thread for now. we'll update CS-2971 with outcomes after the call. :white_check_mark:
